text: Experiment 9 (2026-11-11): SFH prior and the age–redshift slope. Slopes in Gyr per unit redshift. Part 1, prior only (200000 draws of the production StudentT(0, 0.3, df 2) ratios on the 14 bins at each galaxy's redshift): prior median mass-weighted age slope −2.28 for the 135 and −2.31 for the 10 test-set galaxies, 44% of the universe-age slope over the same redshifts (−5.17, −5.24). Prior median age 3.30 Gyr at z = 0.654, 2.75 Gyr at z = 0.891. Part 2, mock chronometer: 10 test-set galaxies × 3 noise seeds, each on its own wavelength grid, masks and uncertainties; truth is constant star formation between cosmic times 2.47 and 3.47 Gyr for every mock (true ages 4.60 Gyr at z = 0.654 to 3.35 Gyr at z = 0.891, true slope −5.24), [α/Fe] +0.2, [Fe/H] −0.2, no C/N, rendered with 0.01 Gyr bins. Production recovery (30 fits): slope −5.63, 95% bootstrap [−6.30, −3.41], ratio to truth 1.07; median age bias +0.57 Gyr (lower-z half) and +0.54 Gyr (upper-z half); age truth inside 16–84% in 10/30; median [α/Fe] bias −0.012, [Fe/H] +0.052. Recovery with StudentT scale 1.0 (30 fits): slope −6.75 [−8.35, −0.82], ratio 1.29; age bias +0.23 / +0.32 Gyr; truth inside 14/30. On these mocks the production prior adds an age offset of about +0.55 Gyr that is the same at both ends of the redshift range and does not flatten the slope. Lead check: slopes and median bias recomputed from prior-slope/per-mock.csv.
